BETA Close X Serco Group plc has announced the purchase of 1,127,000 ordinary shares on June 1, 2026, for an average price of 258.09 pence per share, with the lowest price paid being 255.20 pence and the highest at 263.40 pence. On June 2, 2026, an additional 290,000 shares were bought back at an average price of 257.55 pence, ranging from 256.20 to 259.60 pence. On June 3, 2026, 300,000 shares were acquired at an average of 253.69 pence, between 252.80 and 255.80 pence. On June 4, 2026, another 300,000 shares were purchased at an average of 254.44 pence, with prices between 251.80 and 256.20 pence. Finally, on June 5, 2026, 300,000 shares were bought back at an average of 254.94 pence, ranging from 253.00 to 257.20 pence. Following these transactions, Serco Group plc has 986,930,118 ordinary shares in issue, with 15,815,896 held in treasury. Disclaimer* Serco Group PLC 05 June 2026 05 June 2026 Legal Entity Identifier: 549300PT2CIHYN5GWJ21 Serco Group plc Transactions in own shares Serco Group plc (the " Company ") announces that, in accordance with the terms of its share buyback programme (the " Programme ") announced on 5 March 2026, it has purchased the following number of its ordinary shares of 2 pence each (" Ordinary Shares ") through RBC Europe Limited. The total number of Ordinary Shares held in treasury is 15,815,896 . The total number of voting rights in the Company, excluding treasury shares as at 05 June 2026 is 986,930,118 . This figure may be used by shareholders (and others with notification obligations) as the denominator for the calculations by which they will determine if they are required to notify their interest in, or a change to their interest in, Company or its Group under the Financial Conduct Authority's Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules. Since the announcement of the Programme on 5 March 2026, the Company has purchased a total of 15,815,896 Ordinary Shares, which are held in treasury.
